key_fiscal_facts.value_text: ~60-70% total govt take (royalty 5% + CIT 35% + GNPC equity share)
AOE sliding scale (Additional Oil Entitlement) — cost recovery via R-factor mechanism
35% CIT — Ghana statutory upstream petroleum income tax
Contractor ~40-50% profit oil at low R-factor (AOE sliding, increases with production/price)
5% of gross production — Ghana Petroleum Revenue Management Act statutory rate
GNPC 13.75% carried interest (Jubilee WCTP specific) + ~5% GNPC additional
